page.layout: One page of text; title block at top in large capitals, then a salutation line in italic capitals, then a body paragraph with a woodcut initial O at left; page number centred at foot with catchword "ciam" at right. Margin ornament at upper right is a printer's decoration, not text.

main_text.head: ILLUSTRIBUS ac Præ-potentibus FRISIÆ ORDINIBUS; Patribus Patriæ.
main_text.p: FFERO vobis posthumam PIERII WINSEMII vestri Historiam, cui quidem vivus supremam manum impofuerat, ac in Comitijs vestris obtulerat, eoq; ut typis mandaretur decreto cautum erat: sed cum præsaga mens, quodammodo mortem præsentiens, testaretur, hoc ipso vivo in effectum perduci non posse, illam mihi curam pro veteri familiaritate, commendavit, quod acriter instanti denegare religio mihi fuit: voluit, ut & debuit, illam Illustriss. Dominationibus offerri & inscribi, utpotè quorum autoritate & jussu eam conscripserat: Laudabili sanè ab omni ævo, instituto, ut posteritati constaret ante actorum memoria, & à quam parvis initijs, Majores vestri (benedictione divinâ adjuvante,) supra captum humanum Provinciam

page.notes: The woodcut initial O is decorative and is not transcribed as text. Printed "ILLUSTRES & PRÆ-POTENTES DOMINI;" is set in italic capitals. The head "Patribus Patriæ." is part of the title block. Some letters in the body are faint due to show-through; readings are believed correct.
